segments.contextAfter: Items stored or obtained using the [`kSecAttrSynchronizable`](ksecattrsynchronizable.md) key cannot specify [`SecAccess`](secaccess.md)-based access control with [`kSecAttrAccess`](ksecattraccess.md). If a password is intended to be shared between multiple applications, the [`kSecAttrAccessGroup`](ksecattraccessgroup.md) key must be specified, and each application using this password must have the [`Keychain Access Groups Entitlement`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/BundleResources/Entitlements/keychain-access-groups) enabled, and a common access group specified.
